reason: Pyright is a Node.js CLI type checker that builds from source and runs on CPU with no credentials.
demo: docs/build-debug.md 'Building the CLI' plus docs/command-line.md: run pyright CLI on a Python file
goal: Build the pyright CLI from the cloned source in /work/pyright (pnpm run install:all, then pnpm run build in packages/pyright), as described in docs/build-debug.md. Then `node /work/pyright/packages/pyright/index.js <file.py>` must type-check Python files, report type errors, and with `--outputjson` emit JSON diagnostics. Make sure /work/env.sh puts node and pnpm on PATH.
check: The hidden test runs the built pyright CLI on a small Python file with known type errors and a clean file, and verifies the reported errors, the JSON output and the exit codes.
